_comment: Copy this file to overlay-config.json (same folder) and edit. All keys are optional; anything omitted uses the built-in default. Explicit -Corner/-Margin/-Monitor command-line params override this file.
_icon: Top icon. A full path (e.g. C:\\pics\\myicon.png) OR just a filename if you drop the file next to the script / in assets\\ (e.g. assets\\myicon.png). Empty = use the built-in planet drawing.
_showNms10Logo: Show the NMS10 logo beneath the top icon (true/false).
_nms10Logo: Path/name of the NMS10 logo image. Ships in assets/.
_scale: Size multiplier for the whole card, independent of screen DPI. 1.0 = default; 1.5 = 50% bigger; 0.8 = smaller.
_corner: On-screen corner: TopLeft | TopRight | BottomRight | BottomLeft.
_margin: Gap from the screen edge, in device-independent pixels.
_monitor: 0-based display index to place the overlay on. -1 = primary monitor.
